d:
Tum Humse Pyar Karlo is a sweetheart romantic duet from the 1994 Bollywood classic Mohabbat Ki Arzoo, sung beautifully by the golden pair of Udit Narayan & Alka Yagnik!
Featuring the evergreen Rishi Kapoor and the lovely Zeba Bakhtiar, this timeless melody composed by the legendary Laxmikant-Pyarelal is pure 90s Bollywood romance at its finest.

Movie : Mohabbat Ki Arzoo (1994)

Singer : Alka Yagnik, Udit Narayan
